name: inlay
description: A Markdown editor and viewer that lets you inlay both SVG and HTML.

scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run spdx:check && pnpm run licenses:check && pnpm run notices:check
scripts.mac:build: scripts/build-web.sh && pnpm run mac:generate && xcodebuild -project apps/macos/Inlay.xcodeproj -scheme Inlay -destination 'platform=macOS' -quiet build
scripts.mac:test: scripts/build-web.sh && pnpm run mac:generate && xcodebuild -project apps/macos/Inlay.xcodeproj -scheme Inlay -destination 'platform=macOS' -quiet test
